description: Public Utilities Commission of Sri Lanka - Issuance of Certificate of Exemption - Hambantota International Port Group (Private) Limited
reasoning: This gazette content is a legal notice issued by the Public Utilities Commission of Sri Lanka under Section 10(3) of The Sri Lanka Electricity Act, No. 20 of 2009 (Amended). It involves the issuance of a Certificate of Exemption from licensing requirements, which constitutes a regulatory matter and falls under the category of Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (Type 5). The content does not involve government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or any of the other specialized categories like land, commercial, or public service matters.
